servers.description: List of server pools (groups). Each pool defines a set of backend memcached/Redis instances.

name.description: Unique name for the server pool (e.g., 'redis-cache', 'memcached-sessions').

listen.description: Address (host:port) or Unix socket path where Nutcracker listens for client connections (e.g., '0.0.0.0:6379', '/var/run/nutcracker.sock').

hash.description: Hash algorithm used to distribute keys among backends. Options: 'djb2', 'md5', 'crc16', 'crc32', 'fnv1_64', 'fnv1a_64', 'fnv1_32', 'fnv1a_32', 'hsieh', 'murmur', 'jenkins'.

hash_tag.description: Two-character tag used to extract part of a key for hashing (e.g., '{}', '%%'). Keys are hashed only over the substring between the first and second tag occurrence.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for backend connections and requests.

backlog.description: TCP backlog size for listening socket.

preconnect.description: Whether to preconnect to all backends on startup.

auto_eject_hosts.description: Whether to automatically eject failed hosts (requires `server_failure_limit` and `server_retry_timeout`).

server_retry_timeout.description: Retry timeout (ms) before attempting to reconnect to an ejected host.

server_failure_limit.description: Number of consecutive failures before a host is ejected.

connections.description: Maximum number of connections per backend.

weights.description: Comma-separated list of weights (e.g., '1,1,2') — used only if distribution is 'random' and weighted round-robin is desired.

stats_port.description: Port for per-pool stats (0 = disabled). If 0, falls back to global stats port.

stats_interval.description: Stats update interval (ms) for this pool (0 = inherit global).

stats_admin.description: Admin interface path (e.g., '/admin') for this pool's stats endpoint.

redis.description: Enable Redis-specific features (e.g., support for Redis transactions, errors).

instances.description: List of backend instances in this pool.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend.

port.description: Port number of the backend (e.g., 6379 for Redis).

weight.description: Weight for this backend (used in ketama hashing or weighted random).

timeout.description: Per-instance timeout (ms) — overrides pool timeout if > 0.

family.description: IP address family: 'inet' (IPv4) or 'inet6' (IPv6). Auto-detected if omitted.

log_location.description: Path to log file. Use '-' for stdout.

client_connections.description: Maximum number of client connections (0 = unlimited).
